name: Transformer neutral-earthing conductor reference
aliases: switchyards Switchyard earthing and lightning interfaces
summary: Identifies the conductor connecting the assigned transformer neutral to its specified earthing equipment.
description: Identifies the conductor connecting the assigned transformer neutral to its specified earthing equipment. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Transformer neutral” at the input and “Neutral-earthing equipment” at the output. Its duty differs from a tank protective bond.
